meta.title: Delta Suite
meta.description: Delta Suite: appearance, session assistance, and extensible settings for Harness.

ui.preference: Change the interface theme without affecting sessions, models, or plugins.
ui.unavailable: A required feature is unavailable or an action failed. Disable Delta Suite to restore the official interface.
ui.recovery: If Settings will not open, disable delta-suite in your Harness profile and restart the app.
ui.shortcut: The official layout owns shortcuts; this plugin does not override existing keys.
ui.personalizationDescription: Switch between Delta theme and official theme.
ui.appearanceDescription: Switch between the Delta and official themes without changing sessions, models, or plugins.
ui.hostOwned: Session search and workspace actions still use native Harness services. Disabling Delta Suite restores the official interface.
ui.protectedDefaultWorkspace: The default workspace is protected and cannot be deleted.
ui.signOutFromMenu: Use the account menu to sign out
ui.cannotDeleteSoleWorkspace: The sole remaining workspace cannot be deleted.
ui.integrationSummary: No verified public extension contract is available to Delta for the native features below. Harness retains ownership; Delta does not simulate support with DOM takeover or patches. This is a public API audit, not a live probe of the installed Host.
ui.integrationSidebar: Full sidebar navigation composition: no public composition seat
ui.integrationCollapse: Default-collapsed Workspaces: no public view-state initializer
ui.integrationDeletion: Default Workspace deletion guard: no business-layer guard hook
ui.integrationRunning: Native chat running copy: no dedicated localization override
ui.integrationReasoning: Harness owns the model catalog and reasoning-effort picker; choices appear only when the active adapter advertises them. Delta does not probe models, duplicate the picker, or conflate provider default with explicit Off.
ui.integrationGuidance: To enable full takeover, install a Harness build that publishes the corresponding stable contracts and verify it on the actual client. Existing sessions, themes, and plugins remain available.
ui.searchDialogPrompt: Type to search sessions and workspaces.
ui.contextFeaturesDescription: Harness condenses older conversation automatically as context pressure builds. A compact activity notice appears in the chat; expand it to inspect the structured summary. The original session log is preserved.
ui.showDeepSeekAccountInfoDescription: Show or hide the DeepSeek Account route label in the composer. Sign-in, credentials, model selection, and requests are unchanged.
ui.showModelInfoDescription: Show or hide model names in the message composer. Model selection and requests are unaffected.
ui.deepSeekModelsEnabledDescription: When off, DeepSeek and DeepSeek Account disappear from the model list and new requests to these routes are blocked. Running requests are not interrupted.
ui.inputOptimizationDescription: Preview and edit the optimized text in a separate session. It is added to the composer only after confirmation.
ui.redactionDescription: Mask recognized private-key blocks, labeled credentials, bearer/API tokens, valid payment-card numbers, date/checksum-valid Chinese resident-ID formats, email addresses, and phone numbers before model requests. Tool arguments stay masked. On by default.
ui.optimizationDisabled: Input optimization is disabled in Settings.
ui.assistantUnavailable: Harness sidebar or session services are unavailable.
ui.assistantContext: This panel uses a separate session and will not interrupt the main task.
ui.noCheckpoint: No context summary is available in the loaded session.
ui.automaticCompactionFailed: Context compaction failed. The original session history is preserved.
ui.compactionCompleted: Earlier messages have been compacted. The task will continue using the structured summary.
ui.compactionInterrupted: Context compaction was interrupted. The original session history is preserved.
ui.correctionPlaceholder: Write a correction or addition for the main task…
ui.reviewCorrection: Preview guidance to add to the main task queue
ui.queueOnly: This content will be added to the main task queue without interrupting the current step. Review it before sending.
ui.correctionQueued: Added to the main task queue.
ui.correctionFailed: Unable to add content to the main task queue.
ui.directionChange: This correction may change the task direction. Review its scope before sending.
ui.draftChanged: The composer text has changed. To avoid overwriting it, copy the optimized result or merge it manually.
ui.searchReady: Search and quick actions are available in the sidebar.
ui.searchWaitingServices: Waiting for session and navigation services…
ui.searchWaitingSidebar: Waiting for the sidebar to load…
ui.searchDisabled: Search and quick actions are unavailable in the official theme.
ui.archivedSession: This session is archived. Restore it in the native workspace list before opening.
ui.sessionStateUnknown: Session archive status is unavailable. Open it through the native session list.
ui.mcpAddDescription: Configure and manage MCP services for Harness agents
ui.mcpSubtitle: Manage MCP servers loaded by Harness. Saved configuration takes effect immediately.
ui.mcpSecurityNotice: Custom MCP servers can run code or access external services. Add trusted servers only; reference secrets as ${credential:NAME} instead of entering them directly.
ui.mcpUnavailable: Harness does not provide an MCP management service. Live status, connection tests, and restarts are unavailable, but the settings form can still be used.
ui.mcpNotConfigured: The MCP Manager settings form is not configured.
ui.mcpReadOnly: This configuration is read-only and cannot be saved here. Edit it in the local Harness desktop app.
ui.mcpNameHint: Use 1–32 characters: letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens.
ui.mcpArgsHint: For example, put -y and @modelcontextprotocol/server-github on separate lines.
ui.mcpEnvHint: Reference secrets with ${credential:NAME}; Harness manages them in its credential service.
ui.mcpHeadersHint: Reference credentials with ${credential:NAME} instead of entering long-lived secrets.
ui.mcpNoServers: No MCP servers configured. Add a server to make it available to Harness agents.
ui.mcpDuplicateName: This name is already configured or registered.
ui.mcpInvalidUrl: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL.
ui.mcpInvalidPairs: Enter environment variables and headers as one KEY=value pair per line.
ui.mcpSaveFailed: Save failed and configuration was not changed. Check the name, fields, and current revision, then retry.
ui.mcpRemoveFailed: Unable to remove the configuration. Refresh and try again.
ui.mcpRemoveSuccess: Configuration removed; inherited servers return to their base configuration.
ui.mcpOperationFailed: Operation failed. Check the Harness service status and try again.
ui.mcpStdioNotice: stdio starts the configured command on the Host. Verify that the command source is trusted.
ui.mcpCredentialsNotice: Store secrets in Harness Credentials and reference them using ${credential:NAME}.
ui.mcpFormUnavailable: This Profile does not expose the MCP settings form. Check that the official Harness MCP Manager and Settings are loaded.

sessionMenu.moveDescription: Only Delta's workspace grouping changes. Native Harness session membership and files remain unchanged.
sessionMenu.moveEmpty: No other workspace is available. Add a workspace first.
sessionMenu.deleteDescription: Permanently delete “{title}”? Local session history will be removed and cannot be recovered.
sessionMenu.deleteUngroupedDescription: Permanently delete {count} ungrouped session(s)? Local history cannot be recovered. The empty group will be hidden.
sessionMenu.deleteUngroupedLockedWarning: {locked} session(s) are locked. Only unlocked sessions will be deleted this time. Unlock the others to delete them later.
sessionMenu.unlockFirst: This session is locked. Unlock it first.
sessionMenu.setPinTitle: Set up 2FA code to lock sessions
sessionMenu.setPinDescription: Scan the QR code or enter the secret key in an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password, etc.), then enter the 6-digit code. Locked chats move automatically to Archive.
sessionMenu.pinMismatch: 2FA setup expired. Please reopen and try again.
sessionMenu.wrongPin: The code is incorrect or has expired. Enter a new 6-digit verification code.
sessionMenu.lockedShieldDesc: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator to view this session temporarily or unlock and unarchive it permanently.
sessionMenu.lockedToast: Session locked and moved to Archive
sessionMenu.clearPinDesc: Enter the current 6-digit code from your authenticator to unbind verification and restore all locked sessions.
sessionMenu.pinClearedToast: Session lock 2FA unbound and locked sessions restored
sessionMenu.totpInitFailed: Unable to initialize 2FA setup. Ensure the desktop host is running.

workspaceMenu.unlockFirst: This workspace is locked. Unlock it before continuing.
workspaceMenu.lockedShieldDesc: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator to unlock this workspace.
workspaceMenu.setPinDescription: Use an authenticator app to scan the QR code or enter the secret key, and input the 6-digit code to complete binding. The workspace content will be protected when locked.

privacy.title: Privacy & Data Minimization
privacy.description: Enforces zero Session Log upload/viewing/export, blocks telemetry/crash reporting, and keeps geolocation disabled by default.
privacy.sessionLogBlocked: Session Log collection, viewing & export disabled
privacy.geolocationOff: Geolocation permission off by default (denied unless authorized)
privacy.redactionActive: Sensitive text redaction & in-memory search minimization active

searchPalette.noResultsHint: Search session titles, messages, workspaces, plugins, skills, and shortcuts.
searchPalette.commandCopyHint: Select to copy, then paste into the Harness composer.
searchPalette.commandCopied: Command copied. Paste it into the Harness composer.
searchPalette.commandCopyFailed: Could not copy the command. Enter it in the Harness composer manually.
searchPalette.commandInsertHint: Insert the command into the empty composer, then review and send it manually.
searchPalette.commandInsertFailed: Command not inserted. The draft, session, or permissions changed; use the native composer.
